critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/finalize.py::_compute_open_now — logic is correct but treats a schedule with `enabled=false` as ALWAYS open (`isOpen: True, reason: 'schedule disabled'`). That's fine per current UI contract, but keep in mind: if `state.status == 'paused'` AND `schedule.enabled == false`, /effective-status still returns `effective: 'paused'` (state check runs first) — verified working. No fix needed.

backend/routes/finalize.py::save_channel_schedule — when caller sends `weeklyHours: null`, we substitute the default 09:00–22:00 weeklyHours for every day. That means saving a Simple schedule silently overwrites any previously-customised weekly hours. Consider preserving the existing weeklyHours when mode=='simple' and weeklyHours is null.

backend/routes/finalize.py::_compute_open_now — overrides list is iterated linearly; for tenants with hundreds of overrides this is O(n) per request. Not a scale issue now, but consider indexing by date if overrides > 100.

backend/server.py::NuaAliasMiddleware — good implementation, but note this rewrites the request path at Starlette level. Any middleware installed BEFORE NuaAliasMiddleware sees the original /api/ash/* path. Rate-limit and license middleware here are fine (they don't switch on the /ash vs /nua prefix), but future path-based middleware needs to be aware.
backend/routes/nua.py — module docstring still says 'Ash — the autonomous operating layer endpoints.' Consider updating to NUA to match the rebrand (cosmetic).

frontend/ChannelPauseControl.jsx::defaultSchedule — new-override default is `{ date: today, closed: true }`. If the owner clicks 'Add date' twice, both rows point at today. Fine, but consider auto-incrementing to today+n so the two rows don't overlap silently.
